zh.sourceText: 公司应该鼓励员工每天运动。有数据显示，坚持运动的员工请病假的天数明显更少，长期坚持还能降低焦虑和抑郁的风险。而且，运动带来的精力提升会直接反映在工作效率上，让团队跑得更快。不过，也有管理者担心，安排运动时间会压缩工时，影响项目进度。某健身房在写字楼电梯里投放广告：『每天 30 分钟，激活你的职场竞争力！』

textRefs.conclusion_1: 公司应该鼓励员工每天运动
textRefs.reason_1: 坚持运动的员工请病假的天数明显更少
textRefs.reason_2: 运动带来的精力提升会直接反映在工作效率上
textRefs.distractor_1: 每天 30 分钟，激活你的职场竞争力
textRefs.distractor_2: 安排运动时间会压缩工时，影响项目进度

hints: 结论是给公司的建议，找『应该』句
理由一关于健康（病假），理由二关于效率
管理者的担心和健身房广告，哪个是支持理由？
zh.explanation: 结论是「公司应该鼓励员工每天运动」。理由一：坚持运动的员工病假更少（健康成本下降）；理由二：运动提升精力、提高工作效率（产出上升）。「压缩工时影响进度」是管理者的担忧，属于需要回应的反对意见；「激活职场竞争力」是健身房广告。支撑结论的理由要『直接服务于结论』，广告和担忧都不满足。

en.sourceText: Companies should encourage employees to exercise daily. Data shows that employees who exercise regularly take noticeably fewer sick days, and long-term exercise also lowers the risk of anxiety and depression. Moreover, the energy boost from exercise directly improves work efficiency, helping teams move faster. Some managers, however, worry that scheduling exercise time will cut into working hours and delay projects. A gym advertises in office elevators: '30 minutes a day — power up your career edge!'

textRefs.conclusion_1: Companies should encourage employees to exercise daily
textRefs.reason_1: employees who exercise regularly take noticeably fewer sick days
textRefs.reason_2: the energy boost from exercise directly improves work efficiency
textRefs.distractor_1: 30 minutes a day — power up your career edge
textRefs.distractor_2: scheduling exercise time will cut into working hours and delay projects

hints: The conclusion is a recommendation to companies — find the 'should' sentence
Reason one is about health (sick days), reason two is about efficiency
The managers' worry and the gym ad — which one supports the conclusion?
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'companies should encourage employees to exercise daily'. Reason one: regular exercisers take fewer sick days (lower health cost). Reason two: exercise boosts energy and improves efficiency (higher output). 'Cutting into working hours' is managers' worry — an objection to answer, not a reason. 'Power up your career edge' is a gym ad. A supporting reason must directly serve the conclusion; ads and worries don't.
